hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Central Africa, bordering the South Atlantic Ocean, between Angola and Gabon || coastal plain, southern basin, central plateau, northern basin || about 70% of the population lives in Brazzaville, Pointe-Noire, or along the railroad between them || Resources: petroleum, timber, potash, lead, zinc, uranium, copper, phosphates, gold, magnesium, natural gas, hydropower || Exports: crude petroleum, refined copper, gold, wood, refined petroleum (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: coastal plain, southern basin, central plateau, northern basin || Central Africa, bordering the South Atlantic Ocean, between Angola and Gabon

climate.excerpt: tropical; rainy season (March to June); dry season (June to October); persistent high temperatures and humidity; particularly enervating climate astride the Equator || seasonal flooding

economy.excerpt: primarily an oil- and natural resources-based economy; recovery from mid-2010s oil devaluation has been slow and curtailed by COVID-19; extreme poverty increasing, particularly in southern rural regions; attempting to implement recommended CEMAC reforms; increasing likelihood of debt default || Exports: crude petroleum, refined copper, gold, wood, refined petroleum (2023) || Industries: petroleum extraction, cement, lumber, brewing, sugar, palm oil, soap, flour, cigarettes
